items.summary: In this work, we revisit this formulation and argue that EEG signals carry not only acoustic but also semantic information. items.title: Towards Prosodically Informed Mizo TTS without Explicit Tone Markings
items.summary: This paper reports on the development of a text-to-speech (TTS) system for Mizo, a low-resource tonal language of the Tibeto-Burman family, spoken primarily in the Indian state of Mizoram. items.summary: Speech and audio language models connect continuous acoustic representations to decoders pretrained primarily on text data. items.title: PromptSep-Speaker: Generative Target Speaker Extraction via Multimodal Prompting and Semantic Alignment
items.summary: Target speaker extraction (TSE) isolates a desired speaker from a multi-speaker mixture using cues that identify the target. items.summary: However, existing conversational systems have mainly focused on text or speech, leaving out the visual feedback that is essential for natural interaction. In this paper, we propose JAVIS, an end-to-end streaming framework for real-time audio-visual conversational agents.

items.summary: Simultaneous force & motion control was developed to regulate contact forces commensurate with these constraints, whilst projecting motion control in to the orthogonal, unconstrained directions. items.title: Generative Value Classifier
